regions.note: SeedReach: reach from seeds = least invariant; DNE calibration

chapter_edits.old: **Theorem** (any process). *Reach from a seed.* A configuration is reached from a seed exactly where every property holding at the seed and invariant under the process holds there (`SeedReachProcesses.fromSeed_iff_invariant`), and some such invariant separates it exactly where it is not reached (`separated_iff_not_fromSeed`); a configuration no invariant separates is only not unreached (`not_not_fromSeed_of_not_separated`); with no moves only the seed is reached. **Calibration.** That every process reaches every configuration no invariant separates from the seed is exactly double-negation elimination (`fromSeed_of_not_separated_iff_dne`): reaching a configuration needs a path.
chapter_edits.new: **Theorem** (any process). *Reach from a seed.* A configuration is reached from the seeds exactly where every property holding at the seeds and invariant under the process holds there (`SeedReachProcesses.fromSeed_iff_invariant`), and some such invariant separates it exactly where it is not reached (`separated_iff_not_fromSeed`); a configuration no invariant separates is only not unreached (`not_not_fromSeed_of_not_separated`); with no moves only the seeds are reached. **Calibration.** That every process reaches every configuration no invariant separates from its seeds is exactly double-negation elimination (`fromSeed_of_not_separated_iff_dne`): refuting every separation gives no path, and reaching a configuration needs one ([record](../results/records/reach-from-a-seed.md)).
chapter_edits.why: The seed is a predicate (FromSeed: reached from some seed), so the properties hold at the seeds; the calibration says what the need means; the record link. The anchor_before prefix survives this edit.
